attchmntText: Radaan Mediaworks India Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication for the financial results for quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Radaan Media Works India Limited published a newspaper advertisement regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 on 13th November 2026. Raj Television Network Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 at a Board meeting held on 12th November 2026. Sanco Trans Limited reported a net loss of 7.63 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. AAIL Limited reported a net loss of 2.99 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. W.S. Industries India Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 at a Board meeting held on 12th November 2026.

attchmntText: Radaan Mediaworks India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Radaan Media Works India Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 12th November, 2026. The Board considered and approved the Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. These results include a Limited Review Report. The meeting commenced at 03:30 PM and concluded at 04:00 PM. The financial information will be made available on the Company’s website at www.radaan.tv. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 and 33 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India Listing Regulations.
